record.notes: Based on Government proposal HE 46/2025, the Economic Affairs Committee's report TaVM 18/2025 and Parliament's reply EV 162/2025. Signed by the President on 22 Dec 2025 (countersigned by the Minister of Economic Affairs), published in the Statute Book on 29 Dec 2025 and in force from 1 Jan 2026; the penalty fee for prohibited practices (s. 21) does not apply to breaches that occurred before entry into force. The Act does not apply to Parliament's work and offices, the Parliamentary Ombudsman or the Chancellor of Justice. The maximum penalty fees follow the AI Act: EUR 35 million or 7% of worldwide turnover for prohibited practices, and EUR 15 million or 3% for most other breaches.
